prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one high-fidelity desktop website first-viewport design comp, landscape approximately 1440 by 1080 pixels. A real polished single-page educational web surface, straight-on full bleed screenshot, no browser chrome, no device frame. One surface with next-section glimpse at bottom.

STRUCTURE in order: restrained horizontal website header about 95px tall with wordmark Spironolactone Atlas at left and text chapter navigation Story, Reports, Evidence, Interactions, Methods at right. Fine hairline divider. Hero occupies about 720px: editorial narrative column at left, about 35% width; dominant explanatory horizontal bar figure at right, about 60% width, generously sized and legible. Left column has small monospace eyebrow EDUCATIONAL STUDY, enormous elegant Fraunces-like serif title A medicine, in context. broken into deliberate short lines, concise body "Explore spironolactone through its uses, research evidence and adverse-event reports." Under it coral rectangular action Read the story with a small arrow; secondary understated View data. Right figure has small monospace heading REACTION TERMS IN SELECTED REPORTS, a large clean horizontal bar chart with three aligned rows, plenty of vertical breathing space. Figure should command the opening; all axis labels and values legible, no card container. Beneath figure a measured annotation names denominator and caveat. Near hero bottom a subdued source/date line plus educational-use caption. Next-section glimpse separated by thin hairline shows chapter marker 01 and large serif heading One medicine. Different evidence. with a little introductory text "Label scope, reporting patterns and research findings answer different questions."

FIGURE EXACT DATA: row Hyperkalaemia 3,452; row Acute kidney injury 3,133; row Hypotension 1,832. Bars have common zero baseline and lengths proportional to numbers, first 100%, second 90.8%, third 53.1%; coral first bar and muted teal other two, thin horizontal guide lines and clear endpoint numbers. Axis ticks 0, 1,000, 2,000, 3,000, 4,000. Axis title Reports mentioning term. Exact annotation: "24,805 selected reports · 2004–2025". Exact visible caveat: "Report counts are not incidence or causality." Present as calm legible explanatory text, with subtle leader or bracket annotation expressing the reporting denominator. Source caption "Source: FDA adverse-event reports · Retrieved 3 Nov 2026". Small caption "Educational use only".

VISUAL DIRECTION: Grand Rounds Projection, the annotated projection in a clinical teaching session. Ink-dark clinical teaching field in solid #0B1020, warm ivory text #F3F0E8, primary muted coral #F48F7A and teal #65B8AC. Elegant Fraunces-like serif headlines, crisp Inter body and JetBrains Mono source labels, strong but restrained typographic scale, oversized readable chart captions. Editorial asymmetry, controlled alignment, generous margins approximately 80px, confident calm reading hierarchy. Single dominant figure and supporting quiet narrative, subtle staging implied through numbered annotations and hierarchy only. Flat digital materials, extremely fine rules. No gradients, neon, glow, molecular decoration, kidney or anatomical imagery, stock photos, three-column evidence tables, dashboard widgets, cards gallery, clinical claims, prices, author names, testimonials or invented data. This is a website preview awaiting approval, not a poster. Keep all important copy, scientific term spelling and numerical values exact.

Targeted correction prompt:
Edit the provided website mockup with one precise correction only. Remove the three percentage text labels from inside the horizontal bars: remove "100%", remove "90.8%", remove "53.1%". Seamlessly fill those text regions with their existing bar colors. Preserve absolutely everything else: the bars' existing lengths and positions, endpoint counts 3,452 / 3,133 / 1,832, chart term labels, axis, typography, all website text and spacing, palette and composition, source/date and caveat. The bars must be plain colored bars with counts outside only. No other changes.
